decisions.reason: As a core automation module that strengthens the firm's integrated precast plant offering, the combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot remains strategically important and is unlikely to be withdrawn.
The automatic de-shuttering robot still has value as a modular option for customers who do not adopt the full combined system, even if there is some overlap with broader automation solutions.
The profile storage robot is a more specialized component, but it supports efficient automated workflows and fits the firm's system-solution approach well enough to stay in the range.
The automatic shuttering robot complements both standalone and staged automation investments, so it is likely to be retained despite partial overlap with the combined robot.
The combined magazining cleaning and plotting machine broadens the firm's automation portfolio with multiple models and should be kept as part of its integrated plant concept.

Production analysis software is a natural extension of the firm's machinery and controls business, supporting lifecycle services and data-driven plant optimization, so it is likely to remain on the market.
